title: Closing the Analyze-to-Design Gap: An Authorization-Bounded Agent for Self-Driving Laboratories
abstract: arXiv:2611.25043v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are increasingly integrated into self-driving laboratories (SDLs) to plan experiments and interpret results. However, analytical reasoning alone does not make a laboratory autonomous: autonomy in an SDL is achievable only when the agent can be trusted to act on physical hardware unsupervised and knows when to defer to a human. Here, we present an architecture that integrates an agent at the Analyze-Design interface of the Design-Make-Test-Analyze (DMTA) cycle, enabling agent-driven measurement selection and data interpretation while ensuring that state-changing operations are authorized, validated, and auditable. We demonstrate this architecture on a liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) instrument in an oxidant-screening campaign for synthesizing an organic dye. translated_title: 弥合分析与设计之间的鸿沟：面向自主实验室的授权受限智能体
translated_abstract: 人工智能智能体正日益被整合进自主实验室（SDL）中，用于规划实验和解读结果。然而，仅有分析推理能力并不能使实验室实现自主化：只有当智能体能够在无人监督的情况下被信任去操作物理硬件，并且懂得何时应当交由人类决策时，自主实验室才真正具备自主性。在此，我们提出了一种架构，将智能体集成到“设计-制造-测试-分析”（DMTA）循环中“分析-设计”的接口处，实现由智能体驱动的测量选择与数据解读，同时确保所有改变状态的操作均经过授权、验证并可审计。我们在液相色谱-质谱联用（LC-MS）仪器上展示了这一架构，应用于合成有机染料的氧化剂筛选实验活动。在人类定义的实验活动限制范围内，该智能体提交测量任务、解读质谱（MS）与二极管阵列检测器的数据……
tldr: 该论文提出一种将授权受限的AI智能体嵌入自主实验室DMTA循环“分析-设计”接口的架构，使智能体能在人类设定的授权边界内自主完成测量选择与数据解读，并保证所有改变状态的操作均可授权、验证和审计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an authorization-bounded agent architecture embedded at the Analyze-Design interface of the DMTA cycle in self-driving laboratories, enabling the agent to autonomously select measurements and interpret data within human-defined authorization boundaries while ensuring all state-changing operations remain authorized, validated, and auditable.
